name: GiftPilot – Auto Gift for WooCommerce
author: syedhusnain

sections.description:
GiftPilot automatically adds a free gift product to your customer’s cart — no coupon codes, no manual work, no missed upsells.

Turn every order into a delightful surprise. GiftPilot lets you reward shoppers with a free product the moment they add anything to their cart. Boost average order value, encourage repeat purchases, and make your store feel generous.

✨ Key Features

  • Automatic free gift — Adds a product of your choice to the cart, priced at zero.
  • On/Off toggle — Turn the promotion on or off instantly without losing your settings.
  • Minimum order amount — Only reward customers when their cart meets a value you set.
  • Quantity control — Give 1, 2, or more units of the gift per order.
  • Stock-aware — Respects product stock; never oversells.
  • Friendly customer notice — A polished “Free gift added!” message appears in the cart.
  • Re-adds if removed — If a customer removes the gift, it comes back on the next update.
  • WooCommerce native — Works with the classic cart, checkout, and HPOS.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Running “free gift with every order” promotions
  • Launching a new product with a free sample
  • Rewarding loyal customers
  • Clearing slow-moving inventory as a bonus item
  • Increasing average order value

⚙️ How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Free Gift.
  3. Select the product you want to give away for free.
  4. (Optional) Set a minimum order amount and the gift quantity.
  5. Save — that’s it. The gift is added automatically.

🛠️ Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.0 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the giftpilot-auto-gift-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Free Gift to select your free gift product.
  4. (Optional) Set a minimum order amount and the free gift quantity. Leave the amount empty to always add the gift.
sections.faq:
Can I use a variable product as the free gift?

No. The free gift must be a simple product with its price set to 0.

Can I give more than one free gift per order?

Yes. In the plugin settings, set the “Free Gift Quantity” field to any number of units you want to give away per order. The plugin will respect the gift product’s available stock.

How does the minimum order amount work?

If you set a minimum amount in the plugin settings, the gift is only added when the cart subtotal is greater than or equal to that amount. If you leave the field empty or set it to 0, the gift is added to every order.

Can the customer remove the free gift?

The customer can remove it, but the plugin will re-add it automatically while the cart meets the minimum amount condition.

Can I turn the promotion off without losing my settings?

Yes. Uncheck the “Enable Free Gift” box in the plugin settings. Your product selection, quantity, and minimum amount are kept, so you can turn it back on anytime.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added “Free Gift Quantity” field — set how many units of the gift are added per order.
  • Quantity auto-corrects if the setting changes.
  • Respects stock limits — adds only available quantity.
  • Success notice now shows quantity when more than 1.

1.0.9

  • Added a friendly “Free gift added!” success notice for customers.
  • Added subtle styling to make the notice stand out.

1.0.8

  • Added an Enable/Disable toggle in settings to easily turn the free gift on or off.

1.0.7

  • Renamed plugin to GiftPilot to comply with WordPress.org naming guidelines.
  • Clarified description and FAQ regarding minimum order amount.
  • Added Requires Plugins header.
  • Removed external WooCommerce documentation link.

1.0.6

  • Initial public release.
